newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel's immigrant jobless rate 9 pct in quarter.
newsitem.headline: Israel's immigrant jobless rate 9 pct in quarter.

text.p: The unemployment rate among immigrants who have arrived in Israel since 1990, most of them from the former Soviet Union, stood at nine percent in the third quarter, the Central Bureau of Statistics said on Wednesday.
It noted that the jobless rate for immigrants fell the longer they were in the country. Among those who had arrived since 1995, the rate was 15 percent.
Israel's overall unemployment rate in the third quarter was a seasonally adjusted 6.4 percent. Among immigrants who arrived in 1990-91, the rate was just six percent.

Immigrants accounted 13 percent of Israel's civilian workforce in the third quarter, the bureau said. There were some 543,000 immigrants age 15 and over in the country, of whom 53 percent were in the civilian labour force.
It said 22 percent of immigrants held academic or scientific degrees and 18 percent worked as unskilled labourers.
